law_note: fetch_log.jsonl sha256 values refer to the on-the-wire response bytes. The 13 svc_*.json captures fetched by fetch_svc_windows.sh arrived gzip-encoded and were decompressed in place immediately after fetch (single local gunzip; no content transformation beyond RFC1952 decoding). SHA256SUMS_lane.txt gives the on-disk (decompressed) sha256 per file; reconciliation = refetch logged URL, verify wire sha vs fetch_log, gunzip, verify vs SHA256SUMS_lane.txt.
